name: Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel
insider_take: This grand Georgian mansion turned luxury boutique hotel sits in the heart of Glasgow's cultural quarter, where Victorian elegance meets contemporary Scottish flair.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a magnificent 1823 Georgian townhouse that once served as the headquarters for the Royal Scottish Automobile Club. The building's stunning neoclassical architecture features original period details like ornate cornicing and marble fireplaces, while the rooftop spa offers panoramic views over Glasgow's skyline. Blythswood Square itself is one of Glasgow's few remaining intact Georgian squares.
pro_tip: Book a treatment at the rooftop thermal suite during sunset for breathtaking views over the city, and don't miss the hotel's whisky collection featuring rare Scottish single malts in the sophisticated bar.
dont_miss: The hotel is perfectly positioned for Glasgow's "Golden Z" - the cultural corridor connecting the Royal Concert Hall, Theatre Royal, and Gallery of Modern Art, all within a 3-minute walk. The famous Buchanan Street shopping district and Glasgow School of Art (Charles Rennie Mackintosh's masterpiece) are also just steps away.
pros: Prime city center location on historic Blythswood Square
Elegant Georgian architecture with modern luxury amenities
Kimpton's signature personalized service and pet-friendly policy
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury city center properties
Limited parking availability in historic city center location
